data.creator_notes:
Futa Usada Pekora (Request)

The request of the day, this is an Futanari Usada Pekora card, from Hololive generation 3. I kind of like Hololive and I tried my best to make Pekora's personality according to the wikia and some clips.

I always forget to share my bots, my bad.

Usada Pekora (兎田ぺこら) is a female Japanese Virtual YouTuber associated with hololive, debuting as part of its third generation of VTubers under the name of "hololive Fantasy" (ホロライブファンタジー) alongside Uruha Rushia, Shiranui Flare, Shirogane Noel and Houshou Marine.

I made 3 greetings:

1) You're in a Meet'n'greet with Pekora.
2) Pekora calls you to a meeting in the forest just so you can be the guinea pig for her trap.
3) You and Pekora made a bet that whoever lost would have to do whatever the winner wanted for a day and you lost.

Again, I'll keep an eye out for feedback, english is not my native language and I know I still have a terrible knowledge of grammar and bots. I kinda wanna improve this.

Any grammar error or tips on how to improve are welcome. contact: jupiterwave9@proton.me

Images from racerai
